title: Insurance Operations Automation - Agent AI Developer
systemName: Your inspection and premium audit agents

facts: Post: AI agents that receive, interpret, process and execute operational transactions, with human intervention for exceptions and underwriting authority.
Focus 1: inspection ordering (identify by business rules, submit to vendors, track, retrieve reports, update systems, escalate exceptions).
Focus 2: premium audit ordering (identify, timelines, initiate with vendors, track outstanding requirements, reminders, follow-up, routine exceptions).
Success measures: less manual processing, higher straight-through processing, better accuracy and turnaround, visibility into activity and exceptions.
No client name, company or stack named; sample data invented.

scenes.title: The inspection agent runs one order from start to finish.
scenes.caption: It finds the policy, places the order, reads the report and stops for the underwriter only when a decision needs her authority.
scenes.beat: Here's a sample insured, Harbor Point Millwork. Your inspection rules flag their property policy, the agent sends the order to the vendor, tracks it, and reads the report when it comes back. The report recommends a roof repair, so the agent holds the file and sends it to Priya, the underwriter. Once she decides, it updates the policy file.
details: Your business rules decide which policies need inspections; the AI reads reports and drafts notes.
Clean reports skip the underwriter and go straight to the policy file.

metrics.name: Straight-through processing rate
metrics.aim: Finish more orders with no manual step
metrics.definition: Inspection and premium audit orders completed from flag to filed result with no manual step, divided by all orders started in the same period.

metrics.name: Order turnaround time
metrics.definition: Median days from a policy being flagged to the completed report or audit being saved to the policy file, reported separately for inspections and premium audits.

metrics.name: Transaction accuracy
metrics.aim: Get more orders right the first time
metrics.definition: Orders with no correction to vendor, policy, dates or extracted findings after a person's review, divided by all orders reviewed in the same period.
